text_block_list.text: One day, as preparations for the overseas campaign were underway—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"It came up.
...The card is the 8 of Spades, right."
choice_data_list: What are you two doing?
What are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing much.
Just heading out on a journey with Stego.
choice_data_list: ...Wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, they're such a good-natured person.
When I asked if I could see your journey,
they agreed in a heartbeat."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just goin' wherever you feel like ain't no fun at all. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This decides where we're going.
First, eight stations north.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me you're leaving our destination up to pure chance...!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thrilling, isn't it?
Are we heading toward heaven, or straight to hell... Heh heh.

There was no way I could just leave them alone...!
I decided to accompany the two of them on their journey.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, 'Scream! Bungee Jump', is it?
...Hey, wanna bet? On whether I can jump without screaming or not.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course.
Then let's set a punishment game for the loser.
It's more exciting that way, isn't it?
choice_data_list: I've ended up in quite an incredible place...!
I've come to quite an amazing place...!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Meooow.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …………There's nothing here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. But
taking it easy like this once in a while ain't so bad."
choice_data_list: And now it's in such a remote place...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"This tug...! Here it comes!
Heh-heh, this catch is gonna be huge...!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice work.
Fufu, I can't afford to fall behind either.
choice_data_list: I can't believe you followed me all the way to a deserted island...!

text_block_list.text:
Leaving myself to fate as I travel across various lands.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a stargazing spot up ahead, huh?
...Not bad.
choice_data_list: But with this weather...

text_block_list.text:
"The forecast says it'll be cloudy until tomorrow morning.
Climbing a snowy mountain just to look at the night sky is utterly reckless..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Heh heh, that really stings, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Exposed to the biting winter wind, desperately climbing a snowy path,
the chances of catching a glimpse of a starry sky were almost zero—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's a gamble so crazy it's almost laughable.
choice_data_list: (...Nakayama, could it be—)

text_block_list.text:
There might not be a one-in-a-million chance of seeing the stars.
...Even so—
choice_data_list: If you move forward, I'll follow you anywhere...!
If you're moving forward, then I'll follow you...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Heh, hahaha! Exactly. Who the hell needs a safe bet, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then hey, Trainer.
Let's have some fun—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The fierce passion that lies beyond madness.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Hehe, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. That sounds just like something you'd say.
...In that case, let me see this through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Kh, phew...!
We must've climbed pretty far by now... Oh—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ! ...Heh, well now...
choice_data_list: W-What happened...?
W-What's wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Look.
...Looks like we won.
—It was a breathtaking sight.

Not a single cloud obscured the night sky.
A blanket of stardust stretched out, almost like an illusion.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...So this is your journey, huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I knew it.
You really are that kind of Umamusume, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You're going across the ocean, aren't you?
...To take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is a path like walking on thin ice,
you will never halt your stride—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Because that's Nakayama Festa for you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Don't fear the edge of death. Seize your hope.
...Just like on this journey.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.
choice_data_list: I'll follow you with my head held high!
I'll hold my head high and follow you too!
Let's make a miracle happen together
Do you want her to come cheer you on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.
choice_data_list: I'll follow you with my head held high!
I'll hold my head high and follow you too!
Let's make a miracle happen together
Do you want her to come cheer you on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Man, you've got some weird tastes.
Taking a bet with odds this terrible.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Look who's talking—you've got a face that says you have no intention of losing either.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A miracle, huh...? Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Scrambling until the very end to seize hope.
If you call that a miracle, then I guess it ain't bad.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't need it. I don't need cheering.
...Just—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just watch closely as I put everything on the line.
That is all.
